raw_content:
```yaml
rules:
- id: "vuln-git-client-plugin-75ea3fe0"
  pattern: |
    File.createTempFile($PREFIX, $SUFFIX)
  pattern-not: |
    createTempFile($PREFIX, $SUFFIX)
  languages: ["java"]
  message: "Insecure temporary file creation detected. Use a method that sets secure file permissions to prevent unauthorized access."
  severity: ERROR
  metadata:
    source-url: "github.com/jenkinsci/git-client-plugin/commit/75ea3fe05650fc6ca09046a72493e2b3f066fb98"
    category: security
    cwe: CWE-377
    owasp: A9:2017
    references:
      - "https://owasp.org/www-community/vulnerabilities/Insecure_Temporary_File"
    technology: java
```
